parsed.rationale: The cluster row carries an empty `members` array and all structural evidence fields (`differing_slots`, `jaccard`, `shared_ancestor`, `shared_field_count`) are null. Without any populated member records describing the actual fields of `Announcement.CodingKeys` and `Playcut.CodingKeys`, there is no grounded evidence to confirm that the two nested `CodingKeys` enums share a meaningful subset relationship beyond what the file-path signal in the cluster_id suggests. `Announcement` and `Playcut` are distinct domain concepts within the Playlist package, so any structural overlap in their `CodingKeys` enums is most likely coincidental (e.g., both happen to encode a common field like `id` or `title`). Recommending a refactor without concrete field-list evidence would risk conflating unrelated coding-key namespaces.
